article.story: GREELEY, Colo. -- — Quinn Denker and Zach Bloch both scored 16 points and Northern Colorado thumped Montana 85-57 on Monday night in a Big Sky Conference regular-season finale. Denker also had seven rebounds for the Bears (20-11, 10-8). Bloch added three steals. Ring Nyeri finished with 15 points — on 6-for-7 shooting — seven rebounds and three steals. Money Williams finished with 17 points and six rebounds to pace the Grizzlies (16-15, 10-8). Kenyon Aguino had 10 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
